status: design contract; not a runtime schema or validated metric implementation

time.unit: profile-declared simulation time unit; every output includes the unit
time.run_horizon: explicit half-open interval [start, end); no default duration
time.warm_up: explicit cutoff within the run horizon; no default duration or fraction
time.observation_window: [warm_up_cutoff, horizon_end); report its duration and excluded warm-up interval
time.cohort_vs_event_rule: cohort metrics follow eligible starts in the observation window; event counts follow event times in the observation window; label which rule applies

metrics.definition: service_start_time - queue_entry_time for one queue episode
metrics.numerator: sum of completed eligible episode waits
metrics.denominator: count of completed eligible queue episodes in the declared cohort
metrics.censoring: episodes without observed service start by horizon end are right-censored and counted separately; never substitute zero or drop without reporting count
metrics.aggregation: report episode count, mean, and distribution summary; patient-level aggregation must be separately declared

metrics.numerator: sum of completed eligible patient intervals
metrics.denominator: count of completed eligible patients in the declared cohort
metrics.censoring: patients without observed first care contact by horizon end are right-censored and counted separately
metrics.aggregation: profile declares the eligible start and first-care event; do not infer them from arrival or queue events

metrics.numerator: sum of completed eligible patient stays
metrics.denominator: count of completed eligible patients in the declared arrival cohort
metrics.censoring: patients still in ED at horizon end are right-censored and counted separately; admission/boarding is not terminal departure
metrics.aggregation: report terminal reason counts separately; each patient contributes at most one terminal stay

metrics.definition: count of terminal patient outcomes whose terminal event time lies in the observation window
metrics.unit: patients per declared observation-window duration, plus raw event count
metrics.numerator: unique patients reaching a terminal outcome in the observation window
metrics.denominator: observation-window duration; report raw count and duration
metrics.censoring: report unfinished patients at horizon end separately; do not count them as terminal throughput
metrics.aggregation: report terminal outcomes by reason; a patient is counted once

metrics.numerator: sum of completed eligible boarding intervals
metrics.denominator: count of completed eligible boarding intervals in the declared cohort
metrics.censoring: boarders remaining at horizon end are right-censored and counted separately
metrics.aggregation: profile must identify boarding-start event; retain ED occupancy until physical departure

metrics.numerator: union duration of busy intervals intersected with observation window; no interval counted more than once per resource unit
metrics.denominator: available staffed capacity-time for the same resources and observation window, as declared by the profile
metrics.censoring: open busy intervals at horizon end are clipped at horizon end and reported as unfinished; unknown availability is not treated as zero
metrics.aggregation: report busy-time numerator and capacity-time denominator with the fraction; resource set and availability policy are explicit

uncertainty.unit_of_replication: complete simulation replication with a recorded seed and input manifest
uncertainty.reporting: report replication count, per-replication metric summaries, and the interval/summary method declared before comparison
prohibitions: do not treat patients or queue episodes from one replication as independent replications
do not compare scenarios with incompatible endpoint, cohort, horizon, or denominator definitions

runner_currently_demonstrates: deterministic one-arrival Macro canary and terminal summary only
